# A page that passes the gate

Point the client at `<host>:<port>` — the generic form a placeholder is for.

Documentation addresses are entitled to appear: 192.0.2.10, 198.51.100.7 and
203.0.113.9, alongside loopback 127.0.0.1 and 0.0.0.0 for a local probe.

An example is admissible once it belongs to no particular project: a service
may cache its own tokens, and any project may adopt the rule unchanged.
